profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer @ Imagine Pediatrics | Healthcare Technology
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) with 5 years of experience primarily in Healthcare Technology. 

At UHG/Optum I worked on MyUHC, a massive consumer-facing digital health and benefits platform with millions of users. In my current role at Imagine Pediatrics, I work on critical internal systems that drive clinical operations. Having contributed and led efforts in both large-scale enterprise healthcare and a rapidly growing healthcare startup, I've experienced scale from both ends and have gained a strong appreciation for making systems adaptable to change.

As a full stack engineer, I have particularly deep experience with UI and modern frontend rendering patterns, GraphQL and REST API design, and database modeling for API workloads. These past 5 years I've been working primarily with TypeScript, React, Node, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL.

I am product-minded, a natural leader and mentor, and a lifelong hacker of all things. I strongly believe in flexible, maintainable, adaptable systems, and I continuously improve some facet of my work each day.

🇺🇸 US Army Veteran - Infantry 2011-2015
🛠️ github.com/tysbrown

For those who are still reading, here are a few specifics:

• I'm a CSS aficionado. Pure CSS, preprocessors, or Tailwind, I'm right at home with them all. Contrary to many full stack SWEs (as the meme goes), I don’t struggle with styling and I pride myself on having a thorough understanding of the DOM and browser. 

• TypeScript/JavaScript - It's my primary language. I've been using it professionally the entire 5 years I've been a SWE on both the frontend and backend.

• React - I picked it up right at the beginning of my career when the React team introduced hooks to the public around 2019, so almost all of my professional experience is in the context of functional components and hooks but of course with some legacy class-based components here and there. I've used React in all the ways. Client-side rendering with Vite, SSG and SSR with Next (and Gatsby before it died), and server components with Next.

• Node - I've built and scaled REST APIs with Express, GraphQL APIs with Apollo and The Guild. I’ve worked with monoliths, modular monoliths, and microservices. 

• SQL/Relational Databases - With PostgreSQL and ORMs such as Prisma, Drizzle, and Sequelize. I’m experienced with data modeling, writing/tuning queries, owning migrations, and integrating data layers with API-backed systems reliably and performantly.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
➙ Full Stack Software Engineer assigned to the Employers and Individuals (E&I) Benefits team to build and maintain APIs and UIs that enable UnitedHealth Group's members to learn about, understand, and track the various benefits they're eligible for under their employer-provided or individual health insurance plans on MyUHC.com.

➙ Worked on a wide range of systems, processes, and technologies to own and solve problems from end-to-end. Namely React, Node, GraphQL, SQL, and Kubernetes/Cloud Infra. Provided technical guidance to product and business, advised on performance, accessibility, and usability tradeoffs.

➙ Collaborated with and supported co-workers by participating in scrum ceremonies, knowledge transfer, design sessions, and implementation planning. Conducted code reviews. Participated in pairing and mob sessions. Mentored interns and junior engineers.

➙ Solved complex frontend problems utilizing modern UI design, rendering, and performance patterns.

➙ Developed and maintained GraphQL APIs in a system of > 100 resolvers using the Apollo ecosystem and modern GraphQL API design patterns. Implemented logging and analytics with Splunk and Datadog to monitor API performance and health and assist with troubleshooting. 

➙ Wrote automated tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.

➙ Worked closely with onshore and offshore teams that maintain upstream services our application depends on.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
➙ Full Stack Software Engineer assigned to the Toyota Tier 2 Rebuild team to build and maintain consumer-facing web application exploretoyota.com, and web-based internal tools. 

➙ Designed, delivered, and maintained new features and bug fixes in an Agile environment. Participated in daily stand-ups and scrum ceremonies.

➙ Collaborated with UI/UX designers, content writers, and other engineers to build a performant, accessible, and useable UI component library consisting of more than 200 components utilizing Atomic Design.

➙ Developed solutions for complex frontend problems utilizing modern UI design patterns.

➙ Participated in developing and maintaining a REST API with Node/Express to organize and expose vehicle and dealership data from 177 upstream Toyota dealerships throughout the southeast region of the US.

➙ Wrote automated end-to-end and unit tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress. Implemented a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions.
